guitar.evidence: Trained knowledge: extremely well documented — SRV's well-worn 1963/1962-hybrid Strat nicknamed "Number One" is among the most famous guitars in blues-rock.

tone.target: strat neck blues lead, warm clean-to-edge breakup with glassy sustain
tone.profile: strat neck blues lead, warm clean-to-edge breakup with glassy sustain
tone.summary: A classic blues setup utilizing a clean preamp (US Deluxe) paired with a vintage-voiced cabinet (US 2x12), emphasizing smooth sustain and natural room ambience for Stevie Ray Vaughan's signature neck lead tone.

rig.name: Stevie Ray Vaughan & Double Trouble - Lenny - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Slightly boost signal level for optimal headroom and clarity.
blocks.gap: The Boost module is used to simulate the gentle push needed for controlled breakup without adding grit.

alternatives.reason: Compression could also achieve sustain, but a simple boost maintains more natural dynamics.

blocks.purpose: Keep the drive section clean to maintain natural tube saturation and avoid excessive grit.
blocks.gap: The 'None' setting is used intentionally to rely solely on the preamp/amp model for organic breakup.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the clean, bright Fender-style tone required for classic blues lead work.
Provide the classic Fender-voiced cabinet sound (2x12) that complements the US Deluxe preamp.
Slightly enhance the midrange presence and warmth while keeping the tone focused for lead playing.
blocks.gap: Manual EQ adjustment is necessary to dial in the specific 'warm clean' character of the target sound.

blocks.purpose: Disabled as per the 'avoid' list (no chorus).
blocks.gap: The module is included but deactivated to ensure compliance with the musical verdict.

blocks.purpose: Add a light, natural room ambience to give the tone depth without sounding washed out.

alternatives.reason: Room reverb is preferred as it provides a more natural, less artificial decay than Plate.

improvements.summary: Upgrade cabinet IR for better realism and natural room sound.

proposals.reason: Enhance the vintage, open-air feel of a blues club setting.
